attempts.summary: Set up a nightly cron job on node1 that pulls /srv/inventory/data from node2 via SSH+tar, stores dated tar.gz archives under /var/backups/inventory, and prunes archives older than 7 days. Verified backup, integrity, and retention logic all work correctly, then performed the mandatory sequential restart of node1 and node2, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of services/data on each.
